messages.subject: coord_flip and facet_grid with scales = "free"
parts:
It seems that coord_flip (still?) doesn't play well with facet_grid when specifying free scales:

set.seed(123)
d <- expand.grid(grp1 = LETTERS[1:2],grp2 = rep(LETTERS[3:5],each = 3))
d$v1 <- sample(letters[6:10],18,replace = TRUE)
d$v2 <- runif(18)

p <- ggplot(data = d,aes(x = v1,y = v2)) + 
facet_grid(grp1~grp2,scales = "free_x") + 
geom_point()
p
p + coord_flip()

I see there have been some discussions about issues like this on the ggplot2 mailing list, but mostly from quite some time ago it seems. Is this a longstanding issue or one that has resurfaced?
